usageNotes: Use this to register a Gotify push-notification server as a cluster-level notification endpoint; the endpoint can then be referenced in notification matchers to route alerts. The caller must hold Mapping.Modify on /mapping/notifications and either Sys.Modify (or Sys.Audit) or Sys.AccessNetwork on /. The name field must be a valid pve-configid (alphanumeric plus hyphens, no spaces), and the token is the Gotify application token — store it securely as it is sent in plaintext to the API.

examples.summary: Register a self-hosted Gotify server for cluster alert delivery

params.name: gotify-alerts
params.comment: Primary Gotify endpoint for Proxmox cluster alerts

tips: The endpoint name must satisfy pve-configid format — use only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; no underscores or spaces.
After creation, verify delivery by triggering a test notification via the Proxmox web UI under Datacenter > Notifications.
Set disable: true if you want to pre-register the endpoint without activating it in any matcher yet.
The Gotify application token must be created in the Gotify UI under Applications before registering the endpoint here.
